channel.description: Recent content in AI on Akshat Gupta

item.title: Cyber Valley AI Startup Bootcamp
item.description: Cyber Valley AI Startup Bootcamp across Stuttgart, Tübingen, and Zurich — foundation models, AI startup formation, and responsible AI.

item.title: Fairness in Machine Learning
item.description: An exploration of fairness in ML systems — defining group, individual, and causal fairness, sources of algorithmic bias, and techniques to address them.

item.title: MESH Hackathon Stuttgart 2023
item.description: Building AI prototypes in 48 hours at the MESH Hackathon in Stuttgart, Germany — a student and industry innovation event.

item.title: AI Workshop in Ujjain
item.description: An introductory Artificial Intelligence workshop in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, covering AI fundamentals for students and enthusiasts.

item.title: What is an Ontology in a Knowledge Graph?
item.description: A clear explanation of ontologies in AI — the formal schemas that give knowledge graphs their meaning and enable structured machine reasoning.

item.title: LLM Fine-Tuning with LoRA
item.description: How to fine-tune large language models efficiently using LoRA — low-rank adaptation that dramatically reduces compute and memory requirements.

item.title: What Are Knowledge Graphs?
item.description: A plain-language introduction to knowledge graphs — how they represent entities and relationships, and why they're central to modern AI and search.

item.title: Prompt Engineering: The Art of Talking to AI
item.description: A practical guide to prompt engineering — crafting effective prompts for LLMs, covering zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, and advanced techniques.

item.title: How Do You Evaluate LLMs?
item.description: A practical guide to evaluating large language models — benchmarks, automated metrics, human evaluation, and the pitfalls of measuring model quality.

item.title: RAG and LLMs: Using External Knowledge
item.description: A technical introduction to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) — combining LLMs with external knowledge bases for accurate, up-to-date responses.

item.title: Understanding Attention in Transformers
item.description: A deep dive into self-attention — how it works, why it powers modern Transformers, and the attention variants used in GPT, BERT, and LLaMA.

item.title: Model Extraction Attacks Explained
item.description: A theory and math-first explainer on model extraction attacks — how adversaries steal ML models through queries, and principled defences.

item.title: Memory in Large Language Models
item.description: How LLMs manage memory across three time scales — context windows, KV caches, and RAG-based retrieval — and what this means for building AI systems.

item.title: Speaker Anonymization in the AI Era
item.description: A theory and math-first explainer on speaker anonymization — voice conversion, pitch modulation, and differential privacy for protecting speaker identity.

item.title: LLM Agents: AI Systems That Reason and Act
item.description: A theory and math-first guide to LLM agents — how autonomous AI systems reason, plan, act, and remember, with formal architectural principles.
